sequence: Each separate corpus job: helper contracts and exact source preflight, then A/default-off, then B/enabled, then complete comparison. One additional source-only old-reader contract job.
runs: One full fresh process per arm/corpus; retain every failed attempt; source and protocol frozen before first acquisition. No unchanged retries.
source: Exact343 portable corpus/helper/oracles and independent original lazy-ID decoder recovered from persistent Git; only source manifest, evidence-root location, and previous-reader floor13/a300 assertions change. The runtime remains exact85a8 for both corpus arms.
oracles: Every original pinned archive, CRC/size, group/order/row/lookup input remains unchanged.
Every actual field row independently decodes to its original resolved/fixed source values and independent score.
Every format4 table entry including unused entries and every original row ID is retained exactly. Full-U admission/fallback counts are recorded.
Every actual final MBTI chunk is reread in bounded ranges and checked against source-field, lookup-payload and full-envelope SHA256 receipts plus stored checksums.
Actual format4 final fields are expanded independently to format2 and checksums updated; complete expanded final files and all logical metadata must match the pinned original corpus oracle exactly.
A/default-off actual files must match the original corpus oracle with only independently linked random generation IDs normalized.
Complete parser-output hashes must match between A/B; every preserved exact JMdict12-group section and all independent VNDB media paths/groups remain checked.
Byte reduction is measured from actual written/drained files and must equal exact changed field bytes, not reservations or hypothetical tables.

SQLite transaction/recovery/restart/lookup outside the focused compatibility tests
